title: Align rules-pack attributionText with verbatim SRD 5.1 preamble
description: The generated rules-pack manifest at packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json carries an abbreviated CC-BY-4.0 attribution under license.attributionText. The exact attribution text required by the SRD 5.1 PDF's first-page Legal Information section is pinned verbatim in packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json (under attribution.text) as of loreweaver-60z. Update the importer's emit.ts so the generated pack carries the verbatim preamble statement (with 'material taken from', the quoted '("SRD 5.1")' parenthetical, the dnd.wizards.com URL, and the /legalcode CC license URL), then regenerate / hand-edit the existing seed pack manifest. Keep the redistribution-disclaimer wording 'Please do not include any other attribution regarding Wizards other than that provided above. You may, however, include a statement on your work that it is "compatible with fifth edition" or "5E compatible."' out of attributionText itself unless a separate field is added — that sentence is a Wizards-side instruction to redistributors, not part of the attribution string Wizards requires us to carry.
acceptance_criteria:
- emit.ts produces license.attributionText equal to the verbatim preamble pinned in packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json (attribution.text)
- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json carries the updated text
- A test asserts the pack manifest attributionText matches the source manifest attribution.text byte-for-byte
- No parser behavior or record-content changes outside the attribution field
- npm run check and relevant tests pass
close_reason: Verbatim attribution text updated in emit.ts, seed manifest regenerated, two byte-for-byte tests added.
